 Advertisement Explore Betting on GOAL IMAGO Rian Rosendaal 31 minutes ago Translated by Van Bronckhorst gives Hadj Moussa update just before Feyenoord v Excelsior
 Share Follow GOAL on Google Advertisement Giovanni van Bronckhorst has given an update on Anis Hadj Moussa just before Feyenoord v Excelsior. The winger will miss Saturday evening's match at De Kuip with an ankle injury he sustained while with the Algeria national team. 
 Doubts had already emerged over Hadj Moussa's availability. An hour before kick-off, it became clear he would not start, with Jerayno Schaken taking his place on the right wing.
 “He is doing a little better. But he was not fit enough to play any minutes today. Hopefully he will make it on Tuesday,” Van Bronckhorst told ESPN. 
 The Feyenoord manager is already looking ahead to the Champions League's return. FC Porto visit De Kuip on Tuesday in the league phase.
 Advertisement Advertisement Against Excelsior, Van Bronckhorst has picked Reiss Nelson on the left wing alongside Schaken. That sends Luciano Valente back into midfield.

 Watch “With two out-and-out wingers and Valente coming from midfield, we have plenty of attacking positions. I think we will win with this team,” said the Feyenoord manager, who also praised Schaken.
 “I think Schaken is developing wonderfully. He is still very young, but plays with great maturity. We are showing our faith in him by starting him today.”
 Advertisement Van Bronckhorst knows Feyenoord have an important week ahead. A few days after facing Porto in the Champions League, they play De Klassieker against Ajax.
 “We also need to win in the Champions League to keep our hopes of reaching the next round alive. But let’s focus on today first,” said the Feyenoord manager.
